field_notes.verbatim_ok: true = text may be copied into shipped content. false = never ship its wording; overlap_check.py indexes it.
field_notes.alignment_ok: true = may be used to choose terms and confirm facts/meaning.
field_notes.machine_extract_ok: true = may be fed to an LLM / parsed in bulk. false = human review only. unclear = prefer human review; do not bulk-extract.
field_notes.license: Verbatim licence or terms summary; VERIFY means confirm by hand before relying on it.
field_notes.distribution: "limited" = releasability-controlled US doctrine (CAC holders). Kept in us-limited/ (git-ignored); excluded from overlap indexing and from any LLM input.
